notes.title: v1.0.1 Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Game crashes when spawning enemies
[/list]
[h3]Enhancement:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Weapons and tools are auto-bonded to quick slots 
[*]Spells are also auto-bonded to spell slots
[*]Background music priority should be the highest
[/list]
[h3]Add:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Support text for left & right mouse clicks
[*]“What’s new screen” at the Main Menu when a new version is released
[/list]
